expectations.text: Explains client-financed acquisition (point-of-sale cash covers this customer AND the next)
Recommends high-ticket packages/challenge offers instead of a cheap commodity membership (e.g., 6-Week challenge, $99/week tiers)
Gives the ~$1,100 average cash per sale (e.g., 1 whale $2,500, 1 above average $1,200, 3 normal $600 out of 5 sales from 10 prospects)
expectations.evidence: Uses own $299 numbers, not the book's $1,100 mix

expectations.text: Calculates spend per show (~$550 per show at 50% close, so ~$275 per show)
Describes the funnel: ad -> opt-in -> scheduling page -> Facebook group, and contacting all leads
expectations.evidence: Funnel lacks scheduling page/Facebook group steps

expectations.text: Mentions the follow-on sales (food, supplements, 12-month, paid in full) and/or the $1 -> $3 reinvestment rule
expectations.evidence: Only a continuation membership; no five-sale sequence or $1:$3 rule
